title: Compile report (output/compile-report.json)
description: Written by fam_latex.finalize from the real compile attempt and static checks. Fields reflect what actually happened; never fill them by hand.

main.description: Relative path of the compiled main .tex.

available.description: true only if a TeX engine (latexmk/pdflatex/xelatex/lualatex) was found and invoked.

ok.description: true only if the engine exited 0 and a PDF appeared.

engine.description: Engine actually used, null if unavailable.

error.description: Engine error text or exit code.

passes.description: Number of passes recorded for the last attempt.

errors.description: Log lines starting with '!' or containing 'Undefined control sequence' (deduplicated, capped).

warnings.description: LaTeX/Package warnings, undefined refs, over/underfull boxes (deduplicated, capped).

balanced_braces.description: Raw brace counts in the main file; escaped braces are still counted.

pdf.description: "main.pdf" only when a real %PDF- file was copied to output; otherwise null.
